rationale: Retain for compatibility, but avoid treating them as governed core inputs.

rationale: Keep as experimental only; do not include in approved sets.

issue: Alternative volatility estimators overlap with simpler rolling volatility features.

feature/group: Raw macro levels (fx_usdvnd, interest_rate, gold_price, oil_price)
issue: Non-stationary level features are scale-sensitive and weaker than returns/z-scores.
rationale: Retain raw levels for diagnostics, but approve only returns/z-score transforms for model inputs.
backward_compatibility_impact: Low. Raw columns remain present when context exists.
